in_hebrew.name: Roth
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Roth הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old Germanic root ‘rōtiz’, meaning ‘red’. In Germanic mythology, Roth represented the earth element and was a symbol of fertility.

in_latin.name: Roth
